get_scene_info.title: Get Scene Info
get_scene_info.description: Get design name, bodies, sketches, features, camera info

get_object_info.name: get_object_info
get_object_info.title: Get Object Info
get_object_info.description: Get detailed info about a named body or sketch

get_bounding_box.name: get_bounding_box
get_bounding_box.title: Get Bounding Box
get_bounding_box.description: Axis-aligned bounding box for a body or component by name. Returns min, max, size, and center in cm (Fusion internal units). For components, unions bounding boxes of all contained bodies. Useful for measuring imported reference geometry.

create_sketch.name: create_sketch
create_sketch.title: Create Sketch
create_sketch.description: Create a new sketch on xy/yz/xz plane, optionally offset

draw_rectangle.name: draw_rectangle
draw_rectangle.title: Draw Rectangle
draw_rectangle.description: Draw a rectangle in the most recent sketch

draw_circle.name: draw_circle
draw_circle.title: Draw Circle
draw_circle.description: Draw a circle in the most recent sketch

draw_line.name: draw_line
draw_line.title: Draw Line
draw_line.description: Draw a line in the most recent sketch

revolve.name: revolve
revolve.title: Revolve
revolve.description: Revolve a sketch profile around an axis

shell.name: shell
shell.title: Shell Body
shell.description: Hollow out a body by removing a face

mirror.name: mirror
mirror.title: Mirror Body
mirror.description: Mirror a body across a construction plane

rename_body.name: rename_body
rename_body.title: Rename Body
rename_body.description: Rename a body (searches root and all components)

move_body.name: move_body
move_body.title: Move Body
move_body.description: Translate a named body by (x, y, z)

export_stl.name: export_stl
export_stl.title: Export STL
export_stl.description: Export a named body as an STL file

delete_all.name: delete_all
delete_all.title: Delete All
delete_all.description: Clear the design (delete all timeline items)

execute_code.name: execute_code
execute_code.title: Execute Code
execute_code.description: Run arbitrary Python in Fusion 360. The last expression's value is returned (REPL-style). Pre-defined names: app, ui, design, component, adsk, math.

sweep.name: sweep
sweep.title: Sweep
sweep.description: Sweep a sketch profile along a path (sketch curve)

path_sketch_name.description: Name of the sketch containing the sweep path

loft.name: loft
loft.title: Loft
loft.description: Loft between two or more sketch profiles

profile_sketch_names.description: Ordered list of sketch names whose first profile will be lofted

create_polygon.name: create_polygon
create_polygon.title: Create Polygon
create_polygon.description: Draw a regular polygon in the most recent sketch

draw_arc.name: draw_arc
draw_arc.title: Draw Arc
draw_arc.description: Draw an arc in the most recent sketch (center + start point + sweep angle)

create_hole.name: create_hole
create_hole.title: Create Hole
create_hole.description: Create a hole feature on a body face

rectangular_pattern.name: rectangular_pattern
rectangular_pattern.title: Rectangular Pattern
rectangular_pattern.description: Pattern a body in rows and columns

circular_pattern.name: circular_pattern
circular_pattern.title: Circular Pattern
circular_pattern.description: Pattern a body around an axis

total_angle.description: Total angle to distribute copies over (degrees)

create_component.name: create_component
create_component.title: Create Component
create_component.description: Create a new component (sub-assembly) in the design

add_joint.name: add_joint
add_joint.title: Add Joint
add_joint.description: Add a joint between two components

list_components.name: list_components
list_components.title: List Components
list_components.description: List all components in the design

export_step.name: export_step
export_step.title: Export STEP
export_step.description: Export a body or component as a STEP file

export_f3d.name: export_f3d
export_f3d.title: Export F3D
export_f3d.description: Export the design as a native Fusion 360 archive (.f3d)

export_view_sheet.name: export_view_sheet
export_view_sheet.title: Export View Sheet
export_view_sheet.description: Render canonical orthographic + isometric views as PNGs and emit a self-contained HTML sheet suitable for sharing with a mechanical engineer. Opens in any browser; Print -> Save as PDF for a static artifact. Restores the viewport camera after rendering.

title.description: Heading shown on the sheet (default: document name).

notes.description: Free-form notes rendered below the views. Newlines preserved; HTML is escaped.

views.description: Ordered list of views to render (default: iso, front, top, right).

export.name: export
export.title: Export (unified)
export.description: Unified export wrapper — dispatches to export_stl / export_step / export_f3d based on format or file extension. Format is auto-detected from file_path extension if not specified. STL and STEP require body_name; F3D exports the whole design.

format.description: Output format. Inferred from file_path extension if omitted.

import_mesh.name: import_mesh
import_mesh.title: Import Mesh
import_mesh.description: Import a mesh file (STL, OBJ, or 3MF) as a mesh body. Returns the mesh name and bounding box. Use for reference geometry (e.g. exported SketchUp model).

component_name.description: Target component name (omit for root component)

get_parameters.name: get_parameters
get_parameters.title: Get Parameters
get_parameters.description: List all user parameters in the design

set_parameter.name: set_parameter
set_parameter.title: Set Parameter
set_parameter.description: Update the value of an existing user parameter

add_constraint.name: add_constraint
add_constraint.title: Add Sketch Constraint
add_constraint.description: Add a geometric constraint in the active sketch. Entities are referenced by index within the sketch.

entity_one.description: Index of the first sketch entity

entity_two.description: Index of the second sketch entity (not needed for fix/horizontal/vertical)

symmetry_line.description: Index of the symmetry line (only for symmetry constraint)

add_dimension.name: add_dimension
add_dimension.title: Add Sketch Dimension
add_dimension.description: Add a driving dimension to constrain sketch geometry. Value is in cm for distances, degrees for angles.

entity_one.description: Index of first entity (point or curve)

entity_two.description: Index of second entity (for distance/angular; not for radial/diameter)

create_construction_plane.name: create_construction_plane
create_construction_plane.title: Create Construction Plane
create_construction_plane.description: Create a construction plane for sketching

edge_name.description: Edge or axis to rotate around (for angle method)

draw_spline.name: draw_spline
draw_spline.title: Draw Spline
draw_spline.description: Draw a spline in the most recent sketch. Use fit_points for a curve through points, or control_points for a control-polygon spline.

offset_curve.name: offset_curve
offset_curve.title: Offset Curve
offset_curve.description: Offset connected sketch curves by a distance. Direction is determined by the direction_point.

curve_index.description: Index of a curve in the connected loop

trim_curve.name: trim_curve
trim_curve.title: Trim Curve
trim_curve.description: Trim a sketch curve at its intersections. The segment nearest to the given point is removed.

curve_index.description: Index of the curve to trim

point_x.description: X near the segment to remove

point_y.description: Y near the segment to remove

extend_curve.name: extend_curve
extend_curve.title: Extend Curve
extend_curve.description: Extend a sketch curve to the nearest intersection. The end nearest to the given point is extended.

curve_index.description: Index of the curve to extend

point_x.description: X near the end to extend

point_y.description: Y near the end to extend

create_thread.name: create_thread
create_thread.title: Create Thread
create_thread.description: Add threads to a cylindrical face (cosmetic or modeled)

thread_type.description: Thread standard (e.g. 'ISO Metric profile', 'ANSI Unified Screw Threads')

thread_length.description: Thread length in cm (only if is_full_length=false)

draft_faces.name: draft_faces
draft_faces.title: Draft / Taper Faces
draft_faces.description: Add a draft angle to faces of a body (for mold release / injection molding)

split_body.name: split_body
split_body.title: Split Body
split_body.description: Split a body using a plane or face

splitting_plane.description: Plane to split with (or use splitting_body)

splitting_body.description: Name of a body/surface to use as splitting tool (overrides plane)

extend_tool.description: Extend tool to cut through entire body

split_face.name: split_face
split_face.title: Split Face
split_face.description: Split faces of a body using a plane

face_indices.description: Indices of faces to split (default: all faces)

offset_faces.name: offset_faces
offset_faces.title: Offset Faces
offset_faces.description: Push/pull faces of a body by a distance

scale_body.name: scale_body
scale_body.title: Scale Body
scale_body.description: Scale a body uniformly or non-uniformly

create_box.name: create_box
create_box.title: Create Box
create_box.description: Create a box primitive (non-parametric via TemporaryBRepManager)

create_box_parametric.name: create_box_parametric
create_box_parametric.title: Create Parametric Box
create_box_parametric.description: Create a history-based rectangular box via sketch rectangle + extrude (unlike create_box which uses TemporaryBRepManager). length/width/height accept a number (cm, Fusion internal unit) or a string expression referencing User Parameters (e.g. 'boxL', '56 mm', 'outer - 2 * wall_t'). Call create_parameter first to define named parameters.

length.description: Along sketch X: number (cm) or expression

width.description: Along sketch Y: number (cm) or expression

body_name.description: Optional name for the resulting body

create_cylinder.name: create_cylinder
create_cylinder.title: Create Cylinder
create_cylinder.description: Create a cylinder primitive (non-parametric via TemporaryBRepManager)

create_sphere.name: create_sphere
create_sphere.title: Create Sphere
create_sphere.description: Create a sphere primitive (non-parametric via TemporaryBRepManager)

create_torus.name: create_torus
create_torus.title: Create Torus
create_torus.description: Create a torus primitive (non-parametric via TemporaryBRepManager)

major_radius.description: Distance from center to tube center

create_as_built_joint.name: create_as_built_joint
create_as_built_joint.title: Create As-Built Joint
create_as_built_joint.description: Create a joint from components' current positions (easier than geometric joints)

measure_distance.name: measure_distance
measure_distance.title: Measure Distance
measure_distance.description: Measure minimum distance between two entities

entity_one.description: First entity name (body, sketch, or point 'x,y,z')

get_physical_properties.name: get_physical_properties
get_physical_properties.title: Get Physical Properties
get_physical_properties.description: Get mass, volume, surface area, center of mass, and density of a body

create_section_analysis.name: create_section_analysis
create_section_analysis.title: Create Section Analysis
create_section_analysis.description: Cut a section plane through the model

set_appearance.name: set_appearance
set_appearance.title: Set Appearance
set_appearance.description: Assign a material appearance to a body, face, or component from the Fusion appearance library

appearance_name.description: Library appearance name (e.g. 'Steel - Satin', 'Aluminum - Anodized Red')

project_geometry.name: project_geometry
project_geometry.title: Project Geometry
project_geometry.description: Project edges or bodies onto the active sketch plane

source_name.description: Name of body or edge to project

is_linked.description: True = parametrically linked to source geometry

suppress_feature.name: suppress_feature
suppress_feature.title: Suppress Feature
suppress_feature.description: Suppress (disable) a feature in the timeline

unsuppress_feature.name: unsuppress_feature
unsuppress_feature.title: Unsuppress Feature
unsuppress_feature.description: Unsuppress (re-enable) a feature in the timeline

patch_surface.name: patch_surface
patch_surface.title: Patch Surface
patch_surface.description: Create a patch surface from boundary edges

stitch_surfaces.name: stitch_surfaces
stitch_surfaces.title: Stitch Surfaces
stitch_surfaces.description: Stitch surface bodies into a single body

thicken_surface.name: thicken_surface
thicken_surface.title: Thicken Surface
thicken_surface.description: Thicken a surface body into a solid

ruled_surface.name: ruled_surface
ruled_surface.title: Ruled Surface
ruled_surface.description: Create a ruled surface from an edge or sketch curve

trim_surface.name: trim_surface
trim_surface.title: Trim Surface
trim_surface.description: Trim a surface body with another body

create_flange.name: create_flange
create_flange.title: Create Flange
create_flange.description: Create a sheet metal flange on an edge

create_bend.name: create_bend
create_bend.title: Create Bend
create_bend.description: Add a bend to a sheet metal body

flat_pattern.name: flat_pattern
flat_pattern.title: Flat Pattern
flat_pattern.description: Create a flat pattern from a sheet metal body

unfold.name: unfold
unfold.title: Unfold
unfold.description: Unfold specific bends in a sheet metal body

bend_indices.description: Indices of bends to unfold (omit to unfold all)

cam_create_setup.name: cam_create_setup
cam_create_setup.title: Create CAM Setup
cam_create_setup.description: Create a manufacturing setup for a body. Defines the stock, coordinate system, and operation type (milling/turning/cutting).

cam_create_operation.name: cam_create_operation
cam_create_operation.title: Create CAM Operation
cam_create_operation.description: Add a machining operation to a setup. Strategy determines the toolpath type.

strategy.description: Machining strategy, under the name Fusion uses internally. Milling: face, contour2d, pocket2d, adaptive2d, adaptive, drill, bore, engrave, trace, slot, parallel, scallop, steep_and_shallow, horizontal, pencil, radial, spiral, ramp, morph, swarf, deburr, thread, chamfer2d, profile2d, pocket_clearing, contour3d. Turning: turning_face, turning_profile, turning_profile_roughing, turning_profile_finishing, turning_groove_roughing, turning_groove_finishing, turning_single_groove, turning_chamfer, turning_thread, turning_part, turning_trace, turning_adaptive_roughing, bar_pull. There is no fixed enum: the valid set comes from Operations.compatibleStrategies and depends on the setup, so call cam_list_strategies rather than guessing.

tool_diameter.description: Tool diameter (cm) — used if tool_number not specified

cam_generate_toolpath.name: cam_generate_toolpath
cam_generate_toolpath.title: Generate Toolpath
cam_generate_toolpath.description: Generate toolpaths for a specific operation or all operations in a setup

cam_post_process.name: cam_post_process
cam_post_process.title: Post Process
cam_post_process.description: Post-process toolpaths to generate NC code (G-code)

operation_name.description: Specific operation (omit to post all in setup)

cam_list_setups.name: cam_list_setups
cam_list_setups.title: List CAM Setups
cam_list_setups.description: List all manufacturing setups in the document

cam_list_strategies.name: cam_list_strategies
cam_list_strategies.title: List Compatible CAM Strategies
cam_list_strategies.description: List the machining strategies a setup accepts, split into turning and milling. Call this before cam_create_operation instead of guessing a strategy name.

cam_get_operation_info.name: cam_get_operation_info
cam_get_operation_info.title: Get CAM Operation Info
cam_get_operation_info.description: Get details about a specific operation (strategy, tool, parameters, toolpath status)

ping.name: ping
ping.title: Ping
ping.description: Health check — returns immediately without touching Fusion API

get_design_type.name: get_design_type
get_design_type.title: Get Design Type
get_design_type.description: Check if the design is in parametric or direct mode. Use this to detect accidental mode switches.

set_design_type.name: set_design_type
set_design_type.title: Set Design Type
set_design_type.description: Switch design type between 'parametric' and 'direct'. Use 'parametric' to recover from accidental direct-mode switches (equivalent to Capture Design History in the UI).

render_view.name: render_view
render_view.title: Render Viewport
render_view.description: Capture the active viewport as a PNG so you can visually verify the model. Pass a canonical view (iso/front/top/etc.) to reposition the camera first, or 'current' to keep it as is. Returns base64-encoded image bytes alongside metadata; the MCP server delivers it as an image content block.

view.description: Camera preset; 'current' preserves the existing view

ecad_new_design.name: ecad_new_design
ecad_new_design.title: New Electronics Design
ecad_new_design.description: Create a new, empty Fusion Electronics design (schematic + PCB) and make it active. Nothing is saved until you call ecad_save_design.

ecad_open_editor.name: ecad_open_editor
ecad_open_editor.title: Open Schematic or PCB Editor
ecad_open_editor.description: Switch the active electronics design to the schematic or the 2D PCB editor. Most commands switch automatically; use this before ecad_command when the editor matters.

ecad_save_design.name: ecad_save_design
ecad_save_design.title: Save Electronics Design
ecad_save_design.description: Save the active electronics design. Only call when the user has asked to keep the changes.

ecad_get_design.name: ecad_get_design
ecad_get_design.title: Get Electronics Design Overview
ecad_get_design.description: Overview of the active electronics design: names, sheets, part, net, element and signal counts, board size, layers in use, net classes, libraries, grid, and whether DRC/ERC have been run.

ecad_list_parts.name: ecad_list_parts
ecad_list_parts.title: List Schematic Parts
ecad_list_parts.description: Schematic parts with value, device, package, library, attributes and where each gate sits (sheet, x, y, angle).

filter.description: Regex on part name or value, e.g. '^R' or '10k'

include_pins.description: Also list every pin with its net and position

ecad_list_nets.name: ecad_list_nets
ecad_list_nets.title: List Nets
ecad_list_nets.description: Schematic nets with the PART.PIN list on each.

netlist_text.description: Also return a sorted 'NET: P.1 P.2' text block

ecad_list_elements.name: ecad_list_elements
ecad_list_elements.title: List Board Elements
ecad_list_elements.description: Placed board components: position, rotation, side, locked, package, value and footprint bounding box.

ecad_list_signals.name: ecad_list_signals
ecad_list_signals.title: List Board Signals
ecad_list_signals.description: Board signals (routed nets): net class, connections, unrouted airwires, track widths and length per layer, vias, and pours.

ecad_search_library.name: ecad_search_library
ecad_search_library.title: Search Part Libraries
ecad_search_library.description: Find devices for ecad_build_design in classic EAGLE libraries: the ones bundled with Fusion (rcl, supply1, pinhead, diode, led, linear, ...) or .lbr/.sch files you name. Returns library, device full name, package, gates and pin names.

query.description: Regex on device name, package or description

library_files.description: Classic EAGLE .lbr, .sch or .brd files on the Fusion PC (their libraries replace the bundled ones)

ecad_build_design.name: ecad_build_design
ecad_build_design.title: Build Electronics Design
ecad_build_design.description: Create a new electronics design (schematic + PCB) from a full spec: parts from classic EAGLE libraries, nets, board outline, net classes, and optional board positions. The way to put a circuit into Fusion; to change the circuit, edit the spec and build again. Each net pin gets a short labelled stub on the schematic; parts without a position are laid out automatically. Reads the result back and reports anything missing. Takes 10-30 s.

output_dir.description: Folder on the Fusion PC to keep the generated .sch and .brd in (default: a new temp folder). The paths come back either way.

device.description: Full device name (R-EU_R0603), or the package variant when deviceset is given

ecad_render.name: ecad_render
ecad_render.title: Render Schematic or Board
ecad_render.description: Picture of the schematic or board as a PNG so you can check placement, routing and silkscreen. Choose a layer preset or a layer list.

ecad_run_erc.name: ecad_run_erc
ecad_run_erc.title: Run ERC
ecad_run_erc.description: Electrical rules check on the schematic; errors grouped.

ecad_run_drc.name: ecad_run_drc
ecad_run_drc.title: Run DRC
ecad_run_drc.description: Design rules check on the board; errors grouped with positions. Optionally load a .dru rule file first.

rules_file.description: Path to a .dru design-rules file to load first

ecad_review.name: ecad_review
ecad_review.title: Design Review
ecad_review.description: Automated review of the whole design: missing values and MPNs, duplicate references, single-pin nets, parts outside the outline, overlapping footprints, decoupling distance, unrouted connections, power tracks too narrow for their current (IPC-2221), missing ground pour, and open DRC/ERC errors.

ecad_add_sheet.name: ecad_add_sheet
ecad_add_sheet.title: Add Schematic Sheet
ecad_add_sheet.description: Add a schematic sheet and make it current.

ecad_add_part.name: ecad_add_part
ecad_add_part.title: Copy a Part
ecad_add_part.description: Add a part to the schematic (and board) by copying a part already in the design with the same device, e.g. one more 100n capacitor. For a device the design does not use yet, add it to the spec and run ecad_build_design.

ecad_set_part.name: ecad_set_part
ecad_set_part.title: Set Part Value or Attributes
ecad_set_part.description: Change a part's value and/or attributes.

ecad_connect.name: ecad_connect
ecad_connect.title: Connect Pins
ecad_connect.description: Connect pins to a named net in the schematic. Draws a short labelled stub from each pin; stubs with the same net name are the same net, so the schematic stays tidy. Pins are 'PART.PIN' using pin names, e.g. ['U1.VDD', 'C3.1'].

ecad_set_outline.name: ecad_set_outline
ecad_set_outline.title: Set Board Outline
ecad_set_outline.description: Draw the board outline on layer 20 (Dimension): a rectangle with optional rounded corners, or a polygon. Replaces any existing outline when replace is true.

points.description: List of [x, y] points in mm

ecad_place.name: ecad_place
ecad_place.title: Place Components
ecad_place.description: Move, rotate and flip board components. Each item: name, x, y, optional angle, side ('top'|'bottom'), lock. One call can place many parts.

ecad_route.name: ecad_route
ecad_route.title: Route Track
ecad_route.description: Draw a copper track for a signal through the given points on one layer. Add vias at layer changes with ecad_add_vias. Width in mm.

points.description: List of [x, y] points in mm

layer.description: Layer number or name: top, bottom, inner2..inner15, tplace, bplace, dimension, trestrict, brestrict, vrestrict, tdocu, bdocu, milling

ecad_add_vias.name: ecad_add_vias
ecad_add_vias.title: Add Vias
ecad_add_vias.description: Add vias to a signal at given points, or fill a region with stitching vias at a pitch (keeps clear of pads and other vias).

points.description: List of [x, y] points in mm

stitch_region.description: Polygon to fill with stitching vias (or omit and set stitch_outline)

ecad_add_pour.name: ecad_add_pour
ecad_add_pour.title: Add Copper Pour
ecad_add_pour.description: Copper pour (polygon) for a signal on a layer, over given points or the board outline, then repour. Use rank to set priority.

layer.description: Layer number or name: top, bottom, inner2..inner15, tplace, bplace, dimension, trestrict, brestrict, vrestrict, tdocu, bdocu, milling

points.description: List of [x, y] points in mm

inset.description: When using the outline, mm inset

ecad_add_holes.name: ecad_add_holes
ecad_add_holes.title: Add Mounting Holes
ecad_add_holes.description: Non-plated holes, e.g. M3 mounting holes (drill 3.2).

ecad_add_text.name: ecad_add_text
ecad_add_text.title: Add Text
ecad_add_text.description: Silkscreen or documentation text on the board.

layer.description: Layer number or name: top, bottom, inner2..inner15, tplace, bplace, dimension, trestrict, brestrict, vrestrict, tdocu, bdocu, milling

ecad_set_net_class.name: ecad_set_net_class
ecad_set_net_class.title: Set Net Class
ecad_set_net_class.description: Define a net class (track width, clearance, via drill) and assign nets to it, e.g. a 'power' class for motor supply nets.

ecad_autoroute.name: ecad_autoroute
ecad_autoroute.title: Autoroute
ecad_autoroute.description: Run the autorouter on the board, or on listed signals only. Route power and sensitive signals by hand first.

ecad_ripup.name: ecad_ripup
ecad_ripup.title: Rip Up Tracks
ecad_ripup.description: Remove routed tracks (all, or listed signals) back to airwires.

polygons.description: Unpour polygons instead of ripping tracks

ecad_ratsnest.name: ecad_ratsnest
ecad_ratsnest.title: Ratsnest / Repour
ecad_ratsnest.description: Recalculate airwires and repour all copper polygons.

ecad_command.name: ecad_command
ecad_command.title: Run EAGLE Commands
ecad_command.description: Run EAGLE commands in the schematic or board editor (the full Fusion Electronics command language: ADD, NET, MOVE, WIRE, CHANGE, POLYGON, VIA, DELETE, GROUP, MITER, ...). Coordinates are mm. Runs as one script and reports what changed.

commands.description: One command per line or array item

ecad_run_ulp.name: ecad_run_ulp
ecad_run_ulp.title: Run ULP
ecad_run_ulp.description: Run an EAGLE User Language Program (.ulp) with arguments, e.g. teardrops.ulp, statistic-brd.ulp. Name a bundled ULP or give a full path.

ecad_export_bom.name: ecad_export_bom
ecad_export_bom.title: Export BOM
ecad_export_bom.description: Bill of materials grouped by value, package and MPN, as CSV. Writes the file when path is given; lists parts missing an MPN.

path.description: Output file path on the Fusion PC

ecad_export_pick_place.name: ecad_export_pick_place
ecad_export_pick_place.title: Export Pick-and-Place
ecad_export_pick_place.description: Centroid file (SMD parts, top and bottom) as CSV.

path.description: Output file path on the Fusion PC

ecad_export_netlist.name: ecad_export_netlist
ecad_export_netlist.title: Export Netlist
ecad_export_netlist.description: Netlist as 'NET: PART.PIN ...' text, optionally to a file.

path.description: Output file path on the Fusion PC

ecad_export_gerbers.name: ecad_export_gerbers
ecad_export_gerbers.title: Export Gerbers and Drill
ecad_export_gerbers.description: Run a CAM job to make Gerber, NC drill and assembly files into a folder (Fusion's Electron.mfgexport). Uses Fusion's bundled 2- or 4-layer job when cam_job is not given. Fusion exports the last saved version, so an unsaved design is refused unless save_first is true.

output_dir.description: Output file path on the Fusion PC

ecad_export_odb.name: ecad_export_odb
ecad_export_odb.title: Export ODB++
ecad_export_odb.description: ODB++ output through a CAM job (Electron.mfgodb).

output_dir.description: Output file path on the Fusion PC

ecad_export_eagle.name: ecad_export_eagle
ecad_export_eagle.title: Export EAGLE Files
ecad_export_eagle.description: Export the schematic (.sch), board (.brd) or used libraries (.lbr) as EAGLE XML: reviewable as text and diffable in git.

path.description: Output file path on the Fusion PC

ecad_calculate.name: ecad_calculate
ecad_calculate.title: Electronics Calculator
ecad_calculate.description: Engineering calculators: trace_width (IPC-2221; current_a, temp_rise_c, copper_oz, layer, length_mm), via_current (drill_mm), divider (vin, vout, series, r_total_min, r_total_max, top), nearest_e (value, series), e_series (series, lo, hi), microstrip_impedance (width_mm, height_mm, er), microstrip_width_for (z0, height_mm, er), led_resistor (supply_v, led_vf, current_ma), rc_filter (two of r_ohm, c_f, fc_hz), resistor_power (r_ohm, v or i), parse_value (value).

docs_list.name: docs_list
docs_list.title: List Open Documents
docs_list.description: List the open documents: name, kind (fusion, drawing, electronics or other), whether each is active and saved, and its cloud file id (null until saved). Works whatever kind of document is active. Use it before docs_activate, and to find the design id for drawing_create.

docs_activate.name: docs_activate
docs_activate.title: Activate Document
docs_activate.description: Make an open document the active one, by name. The name matches with or without Fusion's version suffix ('Bracket' finds 'Bracket v3'). Design tools need a fusion document active, drawing tools a drawing, ecad tools an electronics document.

name.description: Document name, as docs_list shows it

docs_open.name: docs_open
docs_open.title: Open Cloud Document
docs_open.description: Open a cloud file by its file id and make it the active document. Opening a large design can take a while.

file_id.description: Cloud file id (the file_id from docs_list or drawing_create)

drawing_info.name: drawing_info
drawing_info.title: Drawing Info
drawing_info.description: Summary of the active drawing: name, saved flag, cloud file id, and each sheet (index, name, active) with its views (index, type). Works on the active document, which must be a drawing: use docs_list and docs_activate to switch to it.

drawing_create.name: drawing_create
drawing_create.title: Create Drawing
drawing_create.description: Run Fusion's automatic Create Drawing on a design: creates a new drawing file in the design's cloud folder, laid out with views by Fusion. Uses the active design, which must be saved to the cloud, unless design_id is given. Each call creates another drawing file, so call it once and check docs_list before retrying after a timeout.

design_id.description: Cloud file id of the design (default: the active document, which must be a saved design)

template_id.description: Cloud file id of a drawing template

open.description: Open the new drawing and make it the active document

settings.description: Extra properties to set on the API input object, as {property: value}; dotted names walk sub-objects. A string that names an adsk.drawing enum member (e.g. 'A3SheetSize') is set as that member. Numbers are passed to the API unchanged, in its own units.

drawing_autodim.name: drawing_autodim
drawing_autodim.title: Auto-Dimension Drawing Views
drawing_autodim.description: Run Fusion's auto-dimension (Sheet.autoDimension) on one view or every view of a sheet. Fusion chooses what to dimension and where, by the strategy, from the datum corner; the API cannot place a single chosen dimension. Run drawing_tidy afterwards to clear overlaps. Works on the active document, which must be a drawing: use docs_list and docs_activate to switch to it.

sheet.description: Sheet index from 0, as drawing_info lists them (default: the active sheet)

view.description: View index from 0 on the sheet, as drawing_info lists them (default: every view)

datum.description: Datum corner the dimensions run from (DatumPositionsTypes); default: Fusion's

settings.description: Extra properties to set on the API input object, as {property: value}; dotted names walk sub-objects. A string that names an adsk.drawing enum member (e.g. 'A3SheetSize') is set as that member. Numbers are passed to the API unchanged, in its own units.

drawing_tidy.name: drawing_tidy
drawing_tidy.title: Tidy Drawing Sheet
drawing_tidy.description: Run Fusion's tidy-up (Sheet.tidyUp) on a sheet: it re-arranges views, dimensions and labels to remove overlaps. Works on the active document, which must be a drawing: use docs_list and docs_activate to switch to it.

sheet.description: Sheet index from 0, as drawing_info lists them (default: the active sheet)

drawing_export.name: drawing_export
drawing_export.title: Export Drawing
drawing_export.description: Export the active drawing to PDF, DXF or DWG. Writes the file (replacing one already at path) and creates missing folders; the drawing itself is unchanged. Works on the active document, which must be a drawing: use docs_list and docs_activate to switch to it.

path.description: Absolute file-system path of the output file

line_weights.description: PDF only: print with line weights (default true)

sheet_range.description: PDF only: sheets to export, e.g. '1-2' (default: all)
